name_note: The GTDB genus g__Granulicatella also holds genomes that NCBI names Streptococcus or Carnobacterium, so it is broader than Granulicatella as used in papers.

sentences.text: Granulicatella species, previously classified as nutritionally variant streptococci, are fastidious Gram-positive cocci typically part of the normal oral, gastrointestinal and genitourinary flora.
A narrative review consolidating over 100 case reports and clinical studies describes them as organisms that can cause serious infections in both immunocompetent and immunocompromised individuals.
Among 483 patients whose bronchoalveolar lavage fluid was sequenced, those with bacterial pneumonia showed higher colonization rates of Granulicatella adiacens than those without.
A cross-sectional study of 39 children reported that recurrent protracted bacterial bronchitis patients had a distinct lung microbiota with a reduction in genera including Granulicatella.
